path_rule: Direct jump allowed up to 3 releases ahead; EEOL releases can jump to the next 2 EEOL releases. Further than that: stage via an intermediate release.
advisory_ref: Junos release notes: Upgrade and Downgrade Support Policy + Installation and Upgrade Guide
steps: Get change approval, a tested rollback image and go/no-go criteria before the window||Back up configuration and snapshot the current image||Check the release notes for the target release (hardware and feature caveats)||Redundant: install on the backup unit first, reboot it, switch mastership, then install on the other unit||Standalone: install and reboot in the maintenance window; expect a full outage while it restarts||Verify routing sessions, services and licence state before closing the change||Roll back to the saved image if the post-checks fail
basis: Path rule and redundant-unit order: vendor documentation (checked). Durations: illustrative planning estimate.

path_rule: Upgrade with current settings from the firmware page. Confirm in the target release notes whether an intermediate version is needed.
advisory_ref: SonicOS upgrade guide + target release notes
steps: Get change approval, a tested rollback image and go/no-go criteria before the window||Create a system backup and export settings before starting||Upload the firmware and boot it with current configuration||HA pair: the secondary upgrades and reboots first, becomes active, then the primary upgrades and reboots||Standalone: all traffic stops during the reboot||Re-check the HA status screen shows both units healthy||Roll back to the saved image if the post-checks fail
basis: Backup step and HA order: vendor documentation (checked, SonicOS 6.5 HA article and SonicOS 7 upgrade guide). Durations: illustrative planning estimate.

path_rule: Use the tested upgrade path table in the release notes; it may require an intermediate version. Run the external Integrity Checker Tool first when the advisory is exploited in the wild.
advisory_ref: Release notes: Upgrade and Migration + vendor security advisory
steps: Get change approval, a tested rollback image and go/no-go criteria before the window||Run the external Integrity Checker Tool and review the result before upgrading||Take a system and user configuration backup||Follow the tested upgrade path table; do not start the upgrade from the external interface||If compromise is possible, follow the vendor or CISA guidance (factory reset from a known clean image, then patch)||Re-run the integrity check after the upgrade||Roll back to the saved image if the post-checks fail
basis: Integrity check, tested path table and external-interface warning: vendor documentation and CISA guidance (checked). Durations: illustrative planning estimate.

path_rule: Confirm the build is on the supported upgrade path in the NetScaler upgrade documentation. HA pairs must end on the same version.
advisory_ref: NetScaler security bulletin + Upgrade and downgrade documentation
steps: Get change approval, a tested rollback image and go/no-go criteria before the window||Save the configuration and back up the appliance||HA pair: upgrade the secondary node first with sync and propagation disabled||Run a force failover so the upgraded node takes over, then upgrade the new secondary||Re-enable HA sync and propagation once both nodes match||After patching, terminate active sessions if the bulletin asks for it||Roll back to the saved image if the post-checks fail
basis: HA order, force failover and matching versions: vendor documentation (checked). Durations: illustrative planning estimate.

path_rule: Standard upgrade replaces the EOS image and reloads. Smart System Upgrade (reload fast-boot) is possible when the config and FPGA requirements allow it.
advisory_ref: Arista security advisory (web page) + EOS upgrade documentation
steps: Get change approval, a tested rollback image and go/no-go criteria before the window||Copy the image to flash, verify the checksum, free enough flash space||Point the boot configuration to the new image||MLAG pair: upgrade one peer at a time, check MLAG state before the second peer||Standalone: reload in the window; reload fast-boot (SSU) can shorten the outage if the config allows it||Confirm BGP and MLAG state after reload||Roll back to the saved image if the post-checks fail
basis: Image-replace flow, MLAG one-peer-at-a-time and SSU limits: vendor documentation (checked). Durations: illustrative planning estimate.
